fsync.description: AOF fsync policy. An unquoted no in a values file is read as false and is accepted as no.

maxClients.description: Most client connections open at the same time (MAX_CLIENTS).

idleTimeout.description: Seconds without data after which a client connection is closed (IDLE_TIMEOUT). 0 disables the timeout.

password.description: Password required from clients (REQUIREPASS), stored in a Secret created by the chart. Empty disables authentication unless existingSecret is set.

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing Secret that holds the password. Takes precedence over password; no Secret is created by the chart when set.

existingSecretPasswordKey.description: Key in existingSecret that holds the password. Defaults to password.
